### Description

2. Go to '...'

4. See error

### Actual Behavior
What actually happened (e.g. error message, unexpected UI glitch).

- **Browser:** (e.g., Chrome 124.0)
- **Operating System:** (e.g., macOS Sonoma, Windows 11, Ubuntu 22.04)
- **Jira Type:** (Jira Cloud / Jira Server / Data Center)
